title: Phone won't power off during interview

tellings.quote: Let's document all of this. You can see my finger is on the power button

plain: In 2026, while interviewing a British hacker named Gary McKinnon in the UK, Michels says his phone would not switch off. He tells it himself and filmed the moment as it happened: 'Let's document all of this. You can see my finger is on the power button.' He sets it beside McKinnon's story of breaking into NASA computers and finding signs of a secret space programme.
